ordering: Seeded shuffled first sweep, reverse second sweep; frozen ORDER.json before timing
warmup_per_sweep: >=2 complete jobs and >=50ms host interval, executed in groups of4
qualification: All plans and inputs qualified before suite; cached-output check after each timed segment, no per-segment FP64 reference construction
stage_events: Necessary prefix dependency event has timing disabled in formal path; prefix/suffix timestamps only in independent diagnostic
isolated_prefix_metric: GPU complete service interval, two developer blocks geometric mean; both intervals have identical total work
selection_ties: Exact mean ties: native first, lower measured setup proxy, fixed index
alias_rule: Same exact SM sets, execution mode, effective k, background count; labels share one measurement
holdout: Block8-11 new seeds, twice BG calls, unchanged q/family/mode/k
stats: 5000 process-block bootstrap; 97.5% marginal for JOINT_POOL/BEST_NATIVE and /BEST_SIMPLE per main job; otherwise95%
